subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Every day, Mr. Lin took the train to work.”?
options: Every weekend, an old man paints pictures on the sidewalk near the train station.
The day after that, he talked with an old friend he met on the train.
One day, an old woman got on the train and stood beside Lily's seat.
It rang between classes, before lunch, after lunch, and at the end of the day.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Every weekend, an old man paints pictures on the sidewalk near the train station.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The day after that, he talked with an old friend he met on the train.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「One day, an old woman got on the train and stood beside Lily's seat.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It rang between classes, before lunch, after lunch, and at the end of the day.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The day after that, he talked with an old friend he met on the train.」，答案為「The day after that, he talked with an old friend he met on the train.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The day after that, he talked with an old friend he met on the train.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
